items.title: Define retired-root configuration semantics
items.context: Add a small config surface that can mark a project root retired and identify canonicalRoot, without changing normal project behavior.
items.userSees: Project config can explicitly say this checkout is retired and points to /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound as canonicalRoot; read-only commands still show legacy evidence instead of deleting it.

items.title: Enforce retired-root guard before mutating commands
items.context: Use existing command policy ownership classes so read-only commands remain available and story/checklist/validate/evidence writes fail closed with a canonical-root message.
items.userSees: From the retired Orchestrate root, story_create/story_advance/validate --story/checklist_update fail with a clear message that names the canonical proofbound root; session_brief/story_get remain readable.

items.title: Add focused tests for retired-root behavior
items.context: Verify read-only commands still work, mutating commands are rejected, and explicit override is narrow and auditable.
items.userSees: The automated test transcript shows read-only retired-root access passing and mutating retired-root commands rejected unless the explicit human override is set.

items.title: Document Orchestrate retirement and migration recovery path
items.context: Record that B-3523 and B-fbb6 were migrated into proofbound worktrees and that Orchestrate is read-only legacy evidence.
items.userSees: Docs/summary tell future Hosts to use /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound, and show B-3523/B-fbb6 migration recovery paths without claiming old Orchestrate is still active.

items.title: Verify migrated active stories are visible in proofbound and absent from Orchestrate active worktrees
items.context: User-observable migration acceptance: B-3523 and B-fbb6 must be recoverable at /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound/.worktrees/*, while /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate no longer has story/B-3523 or story/B-fbb6 worktrees/branches.
items.userSees: Running session_brief in proofbound lists B-3523 and B-fbb6 as active worktree-authority stories; running session_brief/worktree list in Orchestrate shows no healthy active B-3523 or B-fbb6 worktree.
